observations: Industrial-looking sewing machine on a stand/table (photos 0–3).
Brand text/logo appears to read “emEL” on the machine body (photo 3; also visible faintly on photo 2).
Machine appears to be a straight-stitch/industrial style head (no clear zigzag/ornament controls visible in photos).
Some visible wear/dirt/scuffing on the base/stand and machine casing (photos 1–3).
No clear close-up of model number/serial plate, needle type, or stitch selector (photos 0–3).
No photo shows the motor/power connection, foot pedal, or a running test (photos 0–3).

claims.evidence: Photos show an industrial sewing machine head, but there is no clear stitch-type selector/label or running stitch demonstration (photos 0–3).

risks.risk: Not actually straight-stitch only (could be multi-purpose/other stitch capability) or stitch type not confirmed.
risks.proof: A short video of it sewing a straight seam and showing the stitch settings/selector on the machine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as straight-stitch industrial but treat as unverified capability; use the lowest matching comparable.

risks.risk: May not work reliably (timing, needle bar, feed dogs, tension) since there is no power-on/running test shown.
risks.proof: Video of the machine running with needle moving + sewing a sample fabric for 1–2 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as not proven working (assume needs service).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, presser feet, needle) or parts worn out.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included items laid out (power cable, foot pedal, bobbin case, presser feet, needles).
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only, accessories not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Condition issues: heavy wear, rust, or bent parts on the stand/base affecting stability and performance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base/hinges and the underside/needle area; plus a test showing stable feeding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with cosmetic/operational wear.

proof_requests: Send a video of the machine running and sewing (needle movement + fabric seam) for at least 1–2 minutes.
Show the power setup: motor/power cable and foot pedal (photos or short clip).
Provide close-up photos of any model/serial plate and the stitch/setting controls.
List what is included (bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet, needles, foot pedal, power cable) and show them in one photo.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s an industrial sewing machine and show a brand marking, but there’s no decisive proof it’s straight-stitch and no running test to confirm working condition—so a safe price cannot be set from the provided evidence.
